A successful Massacre knockout roll removes the mixture, starts Reroute Power and Feud, and changes the raid from spread to 6-yard stack until the mixture returns and the next Massacre lands.

repository_audit.finding: Spell IDs, asleep/phase-one/phase-two states, event IDs, and action IDs identify mixture, outage, Feud, Mortality, and heroic Nefarius interactions.
Reset/asleep behavior, engage schedules (Slime/Break/Double at 5s and Massacre at 26s), heroic Nefarius summon, evade/death cleanup, kill world state, and 20% transition are implemented.

Successful Massacre resets melee/Double Attack, applies the 40% then +20% knockout chance, starts Feud on success, and schedules Slime/Break/Double after Massacre; normal event repeats and phase handling are explicit.
Finkle gossip activates Bile-O-Tron and wakes Chimaeron; wake sequence, Bile-O-Tron outage/re-route/return/shutdown, and helper despawn behavior are implemented.

Slime filters current victim and raid-size target count, splits damage by area target count, Double Attack triggers a second strike, mixture reads the SpellInfo threshold and leaves protected lethal hits at 1 HP, Reroute returns mixture, Feud toggles pacify state, and Shadow Whip interrupts casts.
Generic Nefarius casts Shadow Whip during heroic Feud action and Mocking Shadows immediately on heroic phase-two action; heroic death cleanup is scheduled.
BWD has six encounter slots; Chimaeron is DATA_CHIMAERON; boss 43296, Finkle 44202, Bile-O-Tron 44418, and world state 5643 are registered.
Instance maps Chimaeron, Bile-O-Tron, and Finkle data; DONE for DATA_CHIMAERON notifies generic Nefarius progression.

lifecycle.engage: Finkle gossip activates Bile-O-Tron; Chimaeron wake action schedules asleep voice events; engage sends encounter frame/world state and schedules phase-one events. Heroic summons Nefarius.
lifecycle.phase_one: Break/Double/Slime/Massacre; successful Massacre Bile-O-Tron knockout starts outage and Feud; normal Feud pacifies melee while Slime continues; mixture returns via Reroute.
lifecycle.phase_two: Below 20% sets PHASE_2, applies Mortality, schedules immediate Double Attack, stops phase-one event scheduling; heroic Nefarius casts Mocking Shadows.
lifecycle.evade: Disengage, remove boss auras, despawn Bile-O-Tron/Finkle after 0ms+30s, despawn heroic Nefarius, and despawn boss at evade.
lifecycle.death: BossAI DONE path, encounter disengage/aura cleanup, Bile-O-Tron shutdown after 6s, Finkle death talk after 6s, heroic Nefarius defeat action; instance DONE notifies generic Nefarius.
lifecycle.retail_credit_status: Repository progression state only; retail loot, lockout, achievement, and reset persistence unresolved.
